plan.notes: Transcribed from the official Hartnell College 2025-2026 catalog program page 'Nursing-Vocational Nursing' (AS.NVN). The catalog sequences the three-semester professional phase taken after acceptance; modeled here as professional-phase per build.py convention. The following MUST be completed before acceptance and are carried under external_prereqs: ENGL C1000 (or ENGL C1000E), STAT C1000, PSYC C1000 (must be within 5 years of entry), LIB 6, BIO 11 (or BIO 5 + BIO 6 + BIO 6L, within 5 years), and one Local GE Area 6 (Ethnic Studies) course. NUTR 51 or NUTR 1 (3.0) and NVN 70 or PSY 25 (3.0) are listed in the 1st semester and may be taken before beginning the program. NVN 119 units (4.0): the 2025-2026 catalog course page confirms NVN 119 in the 1st-semester sequence; 4.0 per the official 2018 Hartnell VN program proposal (same course, same sequence position) and consistent with the 16.0-unit semester. Semester sums: 16.0 + 14.0 + 14.0 = 44.0, verified. The cohort is lock-step: Semester 2 follows Semester 1, Semester 3 follows Semester 2; NVN 130A/B/C (Basic Pharmacology A/B/C) are sequential. NVN 225/226/227 success courses are recommended, not required, and are excluded. Minimum 'C' or 'P' in all nursing courses; admission is by lottery among qualified applicants.
